title: InterviewTranscript
description: Cosmos DB 'interview_transcripts' container document. Partition key: /candidate_id. Merges generate_questions.py output, interview_bot.py's CLI Q&A, and the voicebot's questions.json/answers.json/score.json.

interview_type.description: pre_generated_questions = generate_questions.py (questions only, no answers captured here). cli_scored_qna = interview_bot.py (candidate types answers via input(), LLM scores each). voicebot_warmup = voicebot/voice_bot.py (spoken ice-breakers + transcript-level score).

score.description: cli_scored_qna only — per-question score from interview_bot.py.

qa_pairs.description: cli_scored_qna and voicebot_warmup; '(No response)' preserved as-is for drop-off analytics.

score_extraction_raw.description: Raw LLM scoring response, kept for audit. voicebot_warmup only extracts the first regex-matched number (see prompts/voicebot_transcript_scoring.v1.md risk note); cli_scored_qna writes the raw response with no json.loads validation at all (see prompts/interview_bot_answer_scoring.v1.md risk note).
